name: Furniture and mattresses
note: CBP generally determines the country of origin for furniture and mattresses based on where the primary structural components, such as tabletops, metal cabinets, or foam mattress cores, are fabricated from raw or semi-finished materials. Conversely, simple assembly, co-packaging pre-made bases with tops, attaching electronic controllers, or placing finished mattresses into sofa frames does not constitute a substantial transformation. Written from 15 CBP substantial-transformation rulings outside the dev and held-out splits (D138); every cited ruling was checked against its facts and holding. Costs are illustrative defaults; users edit them.

groups.name: Tabletop and panels
operations: press laminate or wood veneer sheets onto particleboard or MDF substrate
precision cut panels to shape and apply hot melt glue edge banding
mold, cast, and finish engineered stone or quartz tabletops from stone powder and resin

precedent.note: CBP often finds that fabricating the tabletop imparts the essential character and origin of a table (H330862, H338728, N339685), though importing pre-cut laminated MDF boards for complex desk assembly did not control origin (N344246).

groups.name: Frame and base
operations: stamp, shear, laser cut, pierce, and bend steel coil or metal tubing into structural plates, legs, and rails
extrude and shape aluminum rails, posts, and blind slats
weld metal legs, frames, and cabinet bodies and apply powder coating
cut, mold, join, and stain wood pedestal bases and structural legs

precedent.note: Stamping, extruding, and welding metal into structural bodies or frames confers origin when it forms the core structure (H330862, N335242, N338514), whereas manufacturing a wood pedestal alone did not confer origin compared to the stone tabletop (N339685).

groups.name: Foam and upholstery
operations: extrude, layer, and cut polyurethane memory foam to size
cut and sew textile fabrics, fireproof socks, welt cords, and zippered outer covers
enclose foam layers and innerspring coils into sewn fireproof socks and zippered textile covers

precedent.note: Extruding, layering, and cutting memory foam and zipping it into covers in Japan established Japanese origin for the mattresses even after they were placed into sleeper sofas in another country (N348576, N339107, N339646).

groups.name: Controls and mechanisms
operations: populate printed circuit board assemblies for motion, sound, Bluetooth, and height control
assemble mechanical lift, scissor, and cordless spring mechanisms with motors and actuators
manufacture digital hand controllers, power hubs, and electric firebox displays

precedent.note: Populating the main control PCB and assembling the motorized scissor mechanism contributed to origin (N330057), whereas supplying imported hand controllers and control boxes did not confer origin (H330862).

groups.name: Final assembly
operations: mount controllers, brackets, latches, drawers, and hardware onto tabletops, frames, or cabinets
unroll and place finished foam mattresses onto sleeper sofa or ottoman frames
combine and package finished tabletops with pedestals, legs, or bases for retail shipment

precedent.note: Final assembly confers origin when paired with substantial component fabrication or complex multi-part integration (N338514, N344246), but merely co-packaging or minor joining does not transform the components (N348576, N339107, N339646).
